\chapter{Methodology and Sandbox Architecture}
\label{chap:methodology}

Our compilation and verification pipeline operates inside a single-container Linux environment with strict operating-system privilege separation. Untrusted TeX compilation runs under an unprivileged user identifier with shell escape disabled and paranoid file input/output guards \cite{knuth1984texbook}.

\section{Deterministic Citation and Copy-Overlap Auditing}
\label{sec:auditing}

Given a generated LaTeX passage $T$ and a corpus of indexed full-text PDF chunks $\mathcal{P}$ extracted via layout-aware parsing, we normalize token sequences using Unicode NFKC normalization and line-break dehyphenation \cite{lewis2020retrieval}. Any contiguous $n$-gram match of length $n \ge 8$ words is flagged for researcher review together with the source cite key and page number.

\section{Visual Layout and Figure Inspection}
\label{sec:visual}

In addition to textual grounding, camera-ready manuscripts must be free of overfull horizontal boxes, clipped figures, and misaligned tables \cite{lamport1994latex,ammar2018construction}.
